stage.name: Saltfin Graveyard
stage.description:
A caravan searching for artifacts from the Golden Age has accidentally stumbled upon a saltfin nest. The vicious saltfins have them pinned down in the Salt Flat, while dastardly pirates are closing in on them with their salt ships. They've been sending distress signals to Rhodes Island the entire time, so go and save them already!
<Special Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Salt Flat> Enemies passing through have reduced Movement Speed; after stopping for long enough, they will sink in and be defeated
<Saltheap Cannon> Periodically fires a shell forward, dealing Physical splash damage; can launch a nearby ground enemy of 3 Weight or less to the center of the explosion

risk_surviving_sailor.name: Risk-surviving Sailor
risk_surviving_sailor.flavourText: Sailing in the Salt Flat is a hazardous affair to begin with, but some sailors seek even greater thrills, such as hanging from a flying fin, or firing themselves from saltheap cannons. Those who survive tend to go to even more extreme lengths to satisfy their thirst for danger.
abilities: Movement Speed increases briefly when crossing a Rope Bridge or launched by a <Saltheap Cannon>

risk_seeking_sailor.name: Risk-seeking Sailor
risk_seeking_sailor.flavourText: Sailing in the Salt Flat is a hazardous affair to begin with, but some sailors seek even greater thrills, such as hanging from a flying fin, or firing themselves from saltheap cannons.
abilities: Movement Speed increases briefly when crossing a Rope Bridge or launched by a <Saltheap Cannon>

unlucky_flyfin.name: Unlucky Flyfin
unlucky_flyfin.flavourText: A male fin that leaps out of the salt layer during breeding season, gliding briefly in mid-air and releasing unpleasant pheromones. Having one fall onto the deck is seen as an omen of bad luck.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering; after losing Low-Altitude Hovering, becomes stunned for some time before taking off again
Movement Speed briefly increases after taking damage for the first time. Sometimes carries <Risk-surviving Sailor>

bridge_builder.name: Bridge Builder
bridge_builder.flavourText: Portable and quick to build, rope bridges are a convenient way to connect two salt ships. Bridge builders are responsible for constructing them, but they still need others to help hold them in place and prevent them from falling apart.
abilities: Invisible
Builds rope bridges that allow units to cross

garum_gourmet.name: Garum Gourmet
garum_gourmet.flavourText: Sailors recommend their favorite things to each other, including saltfin garum. Some sailors take it a little too far, however, and roll their barrels into each other's faces.
abilities: Movement Speed increases when carrying a Booze Barrel
First attack consumes Booze Barrel to deal heavy Physical damage and create an area where enemies gain increased ASPD and Physical Dodge

bridge_holder.name: Bridge Holder
bridge_holder.flavourText: Portable and quick to build, rope bridges are a convenient way to connect two salt ships. These experienced bridge holders have steady hands, but have not figured out how to fix the structural defects of the bridge.
abilities: Invisible
Builds rope bridges that allow units to cross

lucky_flyfin.name: Lucky Flyfin
lucky_flyfin.flavourText: A female fin that leaps out of the salt layer during breeding season, gliding briefly in mid-air and releasing pleasant pheromones. Having one fall onto the deck is seen as a sign of good luck.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering; after losing Low-Altitude Hovering, becomes stunned for some time before taking off again
Movement Speed briefly increases after taking damage for the first time. Sometimes carries <Risk-seeking Sailor>

rum_gourmet.name: Rum Gourmet
rum_gourmet.flavourText: Sailors recommend their favorite things to each other, including rum. Not that rum needs recommending to begin with—everyone on the crew understands how valuable it is out on the flat, and would love to share it at any time.
abilities: Movement Speed increases when carrying a Booze Barrel
First attack consumes Booze Barrel to deal heavy Physical damage and create an area where enemies gain increased ASPD and Physical Dodge

bloody_chef.name: Bloody Chef
bloody_chef.flavourText: More butcher than cook, the fleet's chefs are more adept at dismembering carcasses than making the aftermath fit for human consumption. The smell of blood from the kitchen is enough to make even the most hardened sailors lose their appetite.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Nearby enemies and <Saltheap Cannons> take far less Physical/Arts damage from sources in the direction of the shield

terrible_chef.name: Terrible Chef
terrible_chef.flavourText: More butcher than cook, the fleet's chefs are more adept at dismembering carcasses than making the aftermath fit for human consumption. No sailor who has seen one dismember a saltfin has the guts to complain about their cooking.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Nearby enemies and <Saltheap Cannons> take far less Physical/Arts damage from sources in the direction of the shield

explosion_chaser.name: Explosion Chaser
explosion_chaser.flavourText: The Saltheap Cannon is driven not by Originium explosives, but by the kinetic power of saltfin sinew. Dissatisfied with this state of affairs, some sailors have taken to stuffing improvised powder into metal tubes, trying to create true explosions.
abilities: Can perform a charged attack, dealing a large amount of Arts Damage to all nearby allied units with a Stun effect
Can ride <Saltfin Shakers>, gaining some of their abilities

explosion_devotee.name: Explosion Devotee
explosion_devotee.flavourText: The Saltheap Cannon is driven not by Originium explosives, but by the kinetic power of saltfin sinew. Dissatisfied with this state of affairs, some sailors have taken to stuffing massive amounts of improvised powder into metal tubes, trying to light up the night sky of the Salt Flat.
abilities: Can perform a charged attack, dealing a large amount of Arts Damage to all nearby allied units with a Stun effect
Can ride <Saltfin Breakers>, gaining some of their abilities

saltfin_breaker.name: Saltfin Breaker
saltfin_breaker.flavourText: Despite its size and weight, this saltfin is surprisingly lithe when swimming through the salts. Normally gentle in nature, it can shatter even hardened ancient salt layers with its powerful slamming attacks when provoked.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical splash damage to all nearby allied units
Immune to the effects of Salt Flat and gains increased Movement Speed while in Salt Flat

bel_canto_boatswain.name: Bel Canto Boatswain
bel_canto_boatswain.flavourText: The boatswain's saltfin has caught the sailors' attention, but it does not stop bellowing when the boatswain wants it to. Forced to yell above the saltfin's cacophony, the boatswain has developed a bel canto voice so beautiful that it may impress the salt flat itself.
abilities: While on the battlefield, <Risk-surviving Sailor> attacks also inflict Corrosion; Periodically summons 2 <Risk-surviving Sailors>
ATK increases when blocked

cacophonous_boatswain.name: Cacophonous Boatswain
cacophonous_boatswain.flavourText: Maybe it is the loud winds of the Salt Flat, or maybe the sailors are acting floppy—the boatswain constantly suspects that someone is not listening to his commands. Thus, he has grabbed a cacophonous saltfin to catch the sailors' attention.
abilities: While on the battlefield, <Risk-seeking Sailor> attacks also inflict Corrosion; Periodically summons 2 <Risk-seeking Sailors>
ATK increases when blocked

saltfin_shaker.name: Saltfin Shaker
saltfin_shaker.flavourText: Despite its size and weight, this saltfin is surprisingly lithe when swimming through the salts. Normally gentle in nature, it can shake the salt fields and cause land subsidence with its powerful slamming attacks when provoked.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical splash damage to all nearby allied units
Immune to the effects of Salt Flat and gains increased Movement Speed while in Salt Flat
